Overview

Maracaibo is a city in V with a population of 2,000,000. Venezuela’s second city and oil capital, a hot lakeside metropolis known for its unique dialect and the famous Lake Maracaibo lightning. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
